title: Check of lci/mappings.yaml against a licensed background
description: One check of the background names of lci/mappings.yaml (technosphere activities by name, reference product, unit and location; biosphere flows by UUID or name and categories) against a background database in a Brightway project, written by scripts/check_mappings.py to lci/mapping-checks/<date>-<database>.yaml (process-library#303, ADR 0017). It holds the library's own names and the result, never data of the background.

database.description: The background database's name in the project, e.g. ecoinvent-3.11-cutoff.

version.description: The release as its provider names it, e.g. 3.11.

system_model.description: The background's system model, e.g. cutoff.

sites.description: The locations a `location: site` entry was checked for.

mappings_targets_sha256.description: Hash of the checked names (check_mappings.targets_sha256); a different hash of the current mappings makes the record stale.

entry.description: Where the name is in lci/mappings.yaml, e.g. technosphere.nitrogen.

site.description: The location is a site checked for, not written in the mappings.

available_locations.description: Locations at which the background has the same name, reference product and unit.
